title: Bella Learns to Listen
moral: Listening to good advice helps keep you safe.

scenes.summary: Bella the bee enjoys flying but does not listen to advice.
scenes.text:
Bella the Bee Who Didn’t Listen

In a colorful meadow full of bright flowers, lived a busy little bee named Bella.

Bella loved flying from flower to flower.

She collected nectar all day long.

But there was one problem…

Bella didn’t like to listen.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bee flying among colorful flowers in meadow, bright cheerful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bella ignores Queen Bee’s advice and flies too far away.
scenes.text:
“Stay close to the hive,” said Queen Bee.

“And be careful!”

“Okay!” Bella buzzed.

But she didn’t really listen.

She flew far… far away.
scenes.image_prompt: queen bee warning while small bee flies away into distance, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bella gets lost while following distractions in the meadow.
scenes.text:
Bella followed a butterfly.

Then a bright flower.

Then another…

Soon, she didn’t recognize anything.

“Oh no!” she said.

“I’m lost!”
scenes.image_prompt: bee looking confused in unfamiliar meadow chasing butterfly, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Lily helps Bella realize her mistake and guides her back.
scenes.text:
Dark clouds gathered.

The wind blew hard.

“Buzzzz!” Bella cried.

“I don’t know the way back!”

She felt scared and alone.

Just then, Lily the Ladybug landed nearby.

“Why are you upset?” she asked.

“I didn’t listen,” Bella said.

“And now I’m lost.”

Lily smiled kindly.

“I’ll help you,” she said.
scenes.image_prompt: ladybug comforting scared bee under dark clouds, warm cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bella returns home safely and learns the importance of listening.
scenes.text:
Lily showed Bella the path back.

They followed flowers…

Trees…

And familiar smells.

Soon, Bella saw her hive.

“I’m home!” she buzzed happily.

Bella went to Queen Bee.

“I’m sorry,” she said.

“I should have listened.”

Queen Bee smiled.

“I’m glad you’re safe.”

Listening to good advice keeps you safe.

It’s important to pay attention.

The End

story:
Bella the Bee Who Didn’t Listen

In a colorful meadow full of bright flowers, lived a busy little bee named Bella.

Bella loved flying from flower to flower.

She collected nectar all day long.

But there was one problem…

Bella didn’t like to listen.

“Stay close to the hive,” said Queen Bee.

“And be careful!”

“Okay!” Bella buzzed.

But she didn’t really listen.

She flew far… far away.

Bella followed a butterfly.

Then a bright flower.

Then another…

Soon, she didn’t recognize anything.

“Oh no!” she said.

“I’m lost!”

Dark clouds gathered.

The wind blew hard.

“Buzzzz!” Bella cried.

“I don’t know the way back!”

She felt scared and alone.

Just then, Lily the Ladybug landed nearby.

“Why are you upset?” she asked.

“I didn’t listen,” Bella said.

“And now I’m lost.”

Lily smiled kindly.

“I’ll help you,” she said.

Lily showed Bella the path back.

They followed flowers…

Trees…

And familiar smells.

Soon, Bella saw her hive.

“I’m home!” she buzzed happily.

Bella went to Queen Bee.

“I’m sorry,” she said.

“I should have listened.”

Queen Bee smiled.

“I’m glad you’re safe.”

Listening to good advice keeps you safe.

It’s important to pay attention.

The End
